children: won support from BNP Paribas after its GTC Berlin presentations highlighted faster AI data-center deployment and optical networking plans, analyst Karl Ackerman said in a Thursday note.
The bank rates Nvidia Outperform with a $345 price target.

Ackerman said Nvidia is refining its AI factory systems to speed large-scale rollouts and expects its co-packaged optics plans to advance through the second half of 2026 and 2027. The company also presented Vera Rubin systems, Groq 3 LPX and Spectrum-X Photonics switches.

One focus was DSX POD, a pre-integrated AI-factory design that Nvidia says can cut deployment at a prepared site from six months to 14 days. The company is working with 17 partners to deliver the systems in early 2027.

Nvidia plans to lift substrate capacity 2.5-fold over three years with suppliers including Samsung (SSNLF) and Unimicron; a separate agreement involves Amkor (AMKR). Alphabet (GOOGL) plans to offer Google Cloud infrastructure built around Vera Rubin systems in Europe, with expansion to as many as 960,000 GPUs.

title: BNP Paribas Delivers Bullish Message for Nvidia Stock Investors
